newsitem.title: UK: GEC sets up new organisational structure.
newsitem.headline: GEC sets up new organisational structure.

text.p: General Electric Co Plc announced on Wednesday a new organisational structure which halved the number of business divisions within the defence to electronics giant and created a new central management committee.
In future GEC will have five business groups which report to the managing director George Simpson, who took over from the veteran chief Lord Weinstock last autumn.
The businesses are GEC Alsthom, GEC Marconi, GPT, GEC USA amd the industrial group. The group also said that David Newlands, finance director, would deputise Simpson when necessary.

The central organisation team comprises Newlands on finace, Michael Lester on legal affairs who is also vice-chairman, Sarah Morrison on community relations, Sir Geoffrey Pattie on marketing - which is a new position, Rob Meakin on personnel, Jack Fryer on strategic planning and David Grant on technical issues.
The changes will come into effect from April 1.
GEC also said that Richard Needham, former trade minister, will join as non-executive director, chairman of the GPT unit and be responsible for special projects.
